build_alphafold_model: build an AlphaFold model with recycling that predicts protein structure from sequence and MSA input batch
run_alphafold_iteration: run a single AlphaFoldIteration to compute ensembled representations and head predictions from input features
create_evoformer_embeddings: create MSA, single, and pair representations by embedding input data and running the Evoformer stack
compute_distogram: compute a distogram from amino acid positions using dgram_from_positions with configurable bin edges
predict_lddt_confidence: predict per-residue LDDT confidence scores using the PredictedLDDTHead from structure module activations
